decisions.rationale: Adds an opt-in full-cycle RPM source shared by closed-loop idle air and idle ignition timing, including readiness, fallback and a new diagnostic, so idle tuning needs guidance.
evidence: [firmware/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/CHANGELOG.md): Adds opt-in full-engine-cycle RPM feedback with instantaneous fallback and a rollingCycleRpm diagnostic.

[firmware/controllers/actuators/idle_thread.cpp](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/controllers/actuators/idle_thread.cpp): Closed-loop idle air uses rolling RPM only when a complete valid cycle is available.

[firmware/console/binary/output_channels.txt](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/console/binary/output_channels.txt): rollingCycleRpm is zero while disabled or before one complete cycle is valid.

last_sync.summary: Human-reviewed manual recovery audit for experimental cycle-profile ignition angle conversion. Source evidence is pinned at [firmware/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/CHANGELOG.md); guide target for a separate docs PR: docs/11-Ignition/Ignition-Settings/Experimental-Timing.md (not claimed public here). decisions.rationale: Adds an opt-in cycle-profile angle conversion for ignition charge and firing while retaining Legacy as the default; timing requirements and fallback need operator guidance.
evidence: [firmware/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/CHANGELOG.md): Experimental cycle-profile conversion is opt-in, uses supported missing-tooth rising-edge history and falls back to Legacy timing.

[firmware/controllers/trigger/ignition_cycle_profile.cpp](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/controllers/trigger/ignition_cycle_profile.cpp): Recent tooth timing builds the cycle profile and resets on synchronization changes.
